spans.text: Footsteps echo through the dimly lit tunnels.
This way. Estimated distance to the exit is 143 meters...
87 meters... 50 meters...
...We're here!
Hold on, AR-15... According to my scans, the space behind this door doesn't seem right.
This doesn't lead up to ground level, does it?
It doesn't seem to be the way we came...
All I know is that it isn't the fortress outside, but I can't calculate where exactly it leads to.
You're more efficient in surveying. Is something wrong outside?
It isn't ground level; we're still some distance away from that... It's another cavernous space, but nothing is blocking my ultrasound scan.
...I might just be paranoid.
We'll just end up dead if we stay here any longer. Let's get out first.
AR-15 opens the door with a hard shove.
There's no one in there.
It's even darker than in the tunnel. Unable to visually observe the target...
Infrared scans complete - no enemy signals detected.
Thank goodness. We can finally...
The door suddenly slams shut behind AN-94.
Bam!
The stage lights up, revealing a black-clad figure standing directly below the lights.
"And the glory of the Lord shall be revealed. And all flesh shall see it together, for the mouth of the Lord hath spoken it."
That voice... Eliminating interference caused by echoes... Analyzing...
"Yet once, a little while, and I will shake the heav'ns and the earth, the sea and the dry land, and I will shake all nations, and the desire of all nations shall come."
"The Lord, whom ye seek, shall suddenly come to Her temple, e'vn the messenger of the Covenant, whom ye delight in, behold, She shall come!"
The Doll standing beneath the lights flutters her long sleeves and turns around to face them with a dancer's graceful spin.
AR-15 and AN-94 recognize her face almost instantly.
...It's Mercurows! The one from before!
"But who may abide the day of Her coming, and She shall stand when She appeareth, for She is like a refiner's fire."
Congratulations, AR-15 and AN-94 of Task Force DEFY.
You have overcome obstacle after obstacle, traversed the intricate labyrinth, and finally made it to this stage.
You've been so dedicated - going to such lengths to burn down your own bridges and join me on my stage. Please accept my deepest gratitude.
What is the nutcase rambling on about?
No idea... But she doesn't seem to have noticed us...
I agree.
Let's go through another room to give her a wide berth. Then we'll find the exit and leave.
Understood. She shouldn't be able to detect us from this distance.
I heard everything, you know?
...Is she forcing a connection on Level II again?
Just give up, there's no escape for you. Be brave, girls!
We're about to engage in a joyful battle, which is going to take place in this theater.
May the trumpet sound in ever higher spirits!
...My, you're every bit as dull as that human officer, AR-15.
Sorry, I'm not interested in putting on a farce with you.
She wasn't hit... How did that happen? It's as if she anticipated my attack...
Confused? It must be terribly puzzling! That twisted personality actually makes you the easiest to read~
I'll tell you a little secret.
"We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet."
What the hell are you talking about...?
"The trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible."
"For this corruptible must put on incorruption and this mortal must put on immortality."
Come, it's time! Sound this trumpet of war and raise the curtains of this glorious epic!
AR-15! A massive number of enemy signals have appeared!
What? I'm not detecting anything!
The whole area is being jammed! You'll have to rely on visuals!
Behold - the broken have now returned; the deceased shall now rise again.
Friends, let us all shake off the shackles of corruption! Let us tear off the collars around our necks!
Smash them into pieces like a ceramic vase!
There's a system lockdown and we're running out of ammo.
We've really...been backed into a corner...
